scope: Canonical main-CI archive installed in a clean committed Workshops checkout. Production Turbopack public isolation, Page and nested native fields, private drafts, reviewed publication, three booking states, real homepage workshop-feed terminal editing, exactly one native save for a typing burst, repeated pointer/keyboard ordering, locate action and same-page activation. All 16 desktop/mobile captures inspected. Registry publication and the deployed preview are verified in the records below; application PR397 remains open and production is unchanged.

pluginValidation.changesetsResult: passed; pinned official bundled v2.1.2 action, no publication command
pluginValidation.changesetsVersionPRSetting: explicitly approved by the owner and verified enabled; default_workflow_permissions remains read

rootCauses.modalReopen: Consume native modal close transitions once and use a current effect callback; review and custom actions can reopen after close/Escape/failure.
rootCauses.saveBurst: Legacy 100ms autosave plus metadata invalidation and background modified bookkeeping caused duplicate saves. Apply a 1500ms authored-change debounce, pause IME composition, and clear only the unchanged acknowledged snapshot after background completion.
rootCauses.homepageTerminal: The homepage uses editorialWorkshopFeed, not the already bound session-selection module. Share its presentation between server output and native Form projection; recurse nested groups and stable row IDs while keeping business relationships atomic.
rootCauses.galleryIdentity: Keep row IDs, caption values and annotations together while filtering missing media; emit React keys before spreads.
rootCauses.testTypeBoundary: The caret setup referenced a CMS variable named document instead of the DOM ownerDocument. The final app commit uses element.ownerDocument; complete E2E typecheck and exact-head app CI passed.

ui.dock: fixed-size icon actions, accessible spinner/check status and 500ms tooltips
ui.sections: full-width plus Base UI picker; no redundant label/divider
ui.resize: top/left and diagonal resize with quiet thin accent, keyboard controls and Escape cancellation
ui.review: only changed schema leaves and stable-ID structure; published or opening-session comparison; complete signed draft remains the publication unit
ui.boundedValidation: desktop, 320px reflow, reduced motion, dark fields and axe verified; screen-reader speech, RTL and physical touch devices not verified

validationAccess: The first remote attempt used an expired development OIDC token and reached Vercel login. Refreshed the same-project token with vercel env pull, kept deployment protection enabled, removed only the CLI-generated redundant .gitignore line, and reran from clean source. Node-only Security Checkpoint 429 was transport evidence; browser-backed acceptance passed.
